subject: upadate release tool script to valkey (#239)
reason: The change only renames redis to valkey in the maintainers' release tooling (utils/releasetools/*.sh and changelog.tcl): tarball names, upload/scp paths, and a changelog template string. None of these scripts are part of valkey-server, valkey-cli, valkey-benchmark or the check tools; no runtime behaviour, reply, persistence or replication path changes, so no scenario can reach it.
